items.q: she wrote a piece for me to play and a percussionist, Scott Robinson is his name — not the sax player.

ctx.x: Anyway, it’s a very well known school. Anyway, she taught there, a wonderful woman from New Zealand. So she wrote a piece for me to play and a percussionist, Scott Robinson is his name — not the sax player. And we brought all our stuff: conch shells, flutes, whistles, trombones, didgeridoo and all kinds of stuff. And he played all the percussion and conch. So we started doing some stuff, and the piece was called, what is the series where you add one: one plus two is three, it’s a Fibonacci series.
